Job Title
AI / Algorithm Engineer – Vascular Imaging (Bedford, MA) 
 Job Description
 AI / Algorithm Engineer – Vascular Imaging (Bedford, MA) 
   
 Join Philips to bring advanced vascular imaging algorithms from validated prototypes into medical products that clinicians rely on every day. You will be part of a talented, cross-functional team of engineers and scientists who take algorithms from ideation and prototyping, through data annotation and model development, to verification, validation, and regulatory submission in a regulated medical device environment. Your early focus will be on productizing, optimizing, and deploying existing deep learning pipelines for X-ray coronary angiography, with growing ownership of new algorithm development across angiography, intravascular imaging (OCT/IVUS), and other cardiovascular modalities.

 Your role: 
  
 Port, optimize, and deploy existing deep learning pipelines across hardware platforms, improving memory use, throughput, and latency.
 Convert and integrate models across frameworks and runtimes (e.g., ONNX), working with software and systems engineers to deliver robust, maintainable product code.
 Build automated tests and benchmarks demonstrating that ported algorithms reproduce reference results, and document them as verification evidence.
 Develop new algorithms for X-ray angiography, intravascular OCT/IVUS, and other cardiovascular imaging, from ideation and prototyping with clinical partners through product-ready implementation.
 Drive data sourcing, curation, and annotation, and evaluate model performance with rigorous statistical methods.
 Contribute to verification, validation, risk management, and regulatory submissions for AI-enabled medical devices.
  
 You’re the right fit if: 
  
 You have at least 2 years of post-graduation professional experience in algorithms, machine learning, or software development, ideally within a regulated medical device environment. You will contribute as an individual contributor focused on developing and deploying advanced imaging and AI solutions.
 You bring strong Python and TensorFlow skills, including model training, export, and inference, along with experience optimizing deep learning inference on GPU and/or CPU using profiling, memory management, and batching. You also have disciplined software engineering practices such as automated testing, version control, and CI/CD, with bonus experience in ONNX, PyTorch, C/C++, CUDA, cardiovascular imaging, medical-image annotation workflows, and generative AI or LLM-based development tools.
 You have a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. A Master’s degree or PhD is a plus.
 You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position. You will apply these capabilities while performing the essential responsibilities of the role.
 You have a solid foundation in image processing and deep learning for computer vision and can apply these skills to practical development and analysis. You can also leverage modern generative AI tools, such as coding assistants and LLMs, for development, documentation, and analysis.
 You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position .
  
 How we work together: 
  
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
 This is an office-based role.
  
 About Philips: 
  
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.
  
 Learn more about our business .
 Discover our rich and exciting history. 
 Learn more about our purpose. 
 Learn more about our culture. 
  
 Philips Transparency Details: 
  
 The pay for this position in Bedford, MA is $129,000 - $205,000.
  
 The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.   
  
 In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered.  Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more.  Details
 about our benefits can be found here . 
  
 At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case. 
  
 Additional Information: 
  
 US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.
 Company relocation benefits will not be provided for this position.  For this position, you must reside in or within commuting distance to Bedford, MA.
